name: Music Choices
overview: Scripture emphasizes that music choices should center on praising the Lord with heartfelt sincerity, using various instruments and forms such as psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to glorify God (Psalms 150:1,4; Ephesians 5:19; Colossians 3:16). Believers are called to avoid conformity to worldly patterns and instead renew their minds to discern what pleases God, ensuring that their musical expressions reflect truth, purity, and virtues worthy of praise (Romans 12:2; Philippians 4:8). Thus, music in the Christian life is a means of teaching, admonishing, and worshiping with grace in the heart toward the Lord.
